summary: Learn operations performance dashboards and visual management with Excel, KPI trees, and visual boards. Build practical reporting routines for operations.
lede: Operations performance dashboards and visual management turn operational data into clear performance views and daily action routines. This course is for operations professionals who work with operational data and need to report on measures such as throughput, quality, and service levels. It covers KPI hierarchies, Excel and Power Query data preparation, dashboard alerts and trends, and meeting boards that connect exceptions to escalation and follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with operational data and need to turn it into clearer, faster, and more actionable reporting. Operations Managers responsible for daily performance review and escalation. Production Supervisors tracking output, quality, and shift-level exceptions. Continuous Improvement Leads building visual management routines and action follow-up. Business Intelligence Analysts supporting KPI definitions and dashboard logic. Operations Excellence Managers aligning reporting with operational targets. Supply Chain Operations Analysts monitoring service, flow, and delays. Quality Assurance Managers reviewing defect trends and corrective actions. Plant Managers overseeing line performance and management boards. Service Delivery Managers tracking response times and backlog levels. Management Reporting Specialists preparing executive-ready operational summaries.
outcomes: Dashboard Governance and Data Quality Control
prerequisites: You need a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and access to sample operational data if you want to use your own reporting context during exercises. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet functions, filter tools, and simple charts will help you move faster, but advanced coding is not required.
